text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, you got one! Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize, but now that I look<n>closely, it's got
perfect little chibi<n>proportions, doesn't it? All of
them<n>are so sweet.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? All of them are chibi style?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's good. That means my doll self<n>doesn't need
to worry about being<n>the odd one out!
